blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Don't sacrifice great taste for great health. Lifeable gummy vitamins and supplements are bursting with nutrients and fruit flavors so you will actually enjoy taking them. Lifeable - Health gone tasty!

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: As a dietary supplement, take two (2) gummies per day. Chew thoroughly before swallowing.
Do not exceed suggested serving size.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Maltitol, isomalt, water, pectin, citric acid, sodium citrate, natural flavor, beta-carotene (color), vegetable oil (palm), carnauba wax.
Does not contain eggs, wheat (gluten), milk, peanuts, tree nuts, sesame, soy or shellfish. Processed in a nut free facility.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: If you have a medical condition, are taking medication, or are pregnant or nursing, ask a doctor before using.
Not for children under 2 years of age due to risk of choking.
Do not use this product if safety seal under cap is torn or missing.
Keep out of reach of children.
Store at room temperature. Avoid excessive heat.
